Macrons

Consonantal i

SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

campaign noun

a series of military operations

also military campaign, expedition, on campaign

classical

Caes. BG 5.10.1: in expedītiōnem mīsit
Cic. Div. 1.72: in expedītiōnem exercitum ēdūcere (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 186: campaign, expedītiō

expedītiō, expedītiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a campaign, an expedition

Other words

  • stīpendium, stīpendiī n. — a year’s service, a campaign

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Liv. 31.8.11; Tac. Ann. 1.17 (Lewis & Short)

    stīpendia merēre, to serve in the army.

  • aestīva, aestīvōrum n. pl. — the summer camp; a season’s campaign

    noun, second declension, plural · also used · classical · Cic. Pis. 40; Cic. Fam. 3.9.4 (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • postrīdiē ejus diēī māne tripertītō mīlitēs equitēsque in expedītiōnem mīsit, ut eōs quī fūgerant persequerentur

    early the next morning he sent infantry and cavalry out in three columns on a campaign, to pursue those who had fledCaes. BG 5.10.1

See also army, war, battle, soldier, quest, campaign.

SourcesLewis & Short: expeditio · Lewis & Short: stipendium · Lewis & Short: aestivus
